$comment: Rights/applicability manifest, not a flight model. Field guide: README.md in this directory. Schema: data/schema/aircraft-manifest.schema.json.

manufacturer.value: Cessna Aircraft Company (type certificate now held by Textron Aviation)

type_certificate.value: FAA TCDS 3A12; EASA validation TCDS IM.A.051
type_certificate.todo: Read current FAA 3A12 Rev 88 directly (S1); S5 only states alignment with it.

category.value: Normal (4 seats); utility category (2 seats) also certified but not selected
category.note: Normal category selected for this configuration (research recommendation accepted with GAPS Q3, 2026-11-01 10:27).

first.note: First serial with the fuel return system; also after the split avionics master change at 172S8704 (S17 p. 7-34).

last.derivation: NAV III (G1000) option manual applies to serials 172S9810 and on, so the last conventional-panel factory serial before the option is 172S9809. TCDS states no G1000 serial cut-in.
last.note: Conventional-panel aircraft after 172S9810 may exist (NAV III is an option); they are outside this configuration.

panel.derivation: S17 covers the conventional 172S from 172S8001; G1000 begins with the NAV III option at 172S9810 (S18), so the selected range precedes it.

flight_manual.value: Cessna POH/AFM 172SPHUS (TCDS: 172SPHUS-00 applies to the 172S); revision used for research: Rev 5, 19 Jul 2004
flight_manual.todo: Flight-manual revision to model is still open (GAPS Q3); Rev 5 is the copy read, not a decision.

max_rpm_all_operations.conversion: rpm x 2 pi / 60, rounded to 4 decimals
max_rpm_all_operations.uncertainty: Certified limit as published; no tolerance stated.

rated_power.condition: At 2700 rpm (aircraft TCDS); engine TCDS calls this the alternate rating, 134 kW (180 HP) at 2700 rpm
rated_power.conversion: hp x 745.69987158227022 W (mechanical horsepower assumed), rounded to 1 W
rated_power.uncertainty: Rated (minimum) value as published; actual engine power not stated. Engine TCDS 1E10 (S8) not read.

engine_dry_mass.conversion: lb x 0.45359237 kg, rounded to 4 decimals; S9 itself states 122 kg
engine_dry_mass.uncertainty: Engine TCDS dry weight; installed equipment not included.

model.value: McCauley 1A170E/JHA7660 fixed pitch, spinner drawing 0550236 (FAA propeller TC P-857)
